modules.role: entrypoint, profile gates, routes, listeners, teardown, archive mounts

source_composition_facts: TV_ENV sets CASTING_DISABLED, DISABLE_CACHING, NO_CORS, HLS_V2_DISABLED.
UNITY_ENV sets NO_NETWORK_INTERFACES in addition to the TV-style gates.
IOS_APP sets CASTING_DISABLED, HLS_V2_DISABLED, NO_HTTPS_SERVER and installs bridge lifecycle handlers.
HLS v2 is mounted only when HLS_V2_DISABLED is unset.
Casting is mounted only when CASTING_DISABLED is unset and process.platform is not android.
Local-addon indexing is conditional on localAddonEnabled and non-android platform; its router is always mounted.
HTTPS listener is conditional on NO_HTTPS_SERVER; HTTP listener probes ports 11470 through 11474.
Archive routers and IPC downloader mount after the listener; IPC downloader additionally requires SERVER_IPC_KEY.
